entries.title: Minimize a card without closing it
entries.body: The minus beside Maximize takes a card off your stack without closing it or interrupting its crewmate. Click its task in Tasks to bring it back with your picked answers and reply draft. A revised card returns unread. Minimize stays in place across your Macs and restarts. You can also press ⇧⌘M or ask your first mate to show the card again.

picture.alt: A decision card has a minus before Maximize and Close, with its unanswered launch-window choices below
